name: Directory (base, replaceable)
description: Base directory management (decision 2): identity storage stays core; the management rules live here and the plugin is replaceable by slot. Owns the profile-field catalogue rules (field types, security classes, admin configuration validation, effective schema per context, value checking) and the activation effects engine (role diff -> notification + provisioning fan-out, idempotent).
